test_title: PYST 192: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 9th Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/981e206a8f3c4fdacf7f81b58c053eeee24c4ca5545b5dec47e4604ee1d90526.png]
solution:
The square box is changing its position by shifting 90° in clockwise direction, while the shaded triangle in the square box is changing its position by rotating in clockwise direction.

The arrow is also changing its position by shifting 90° in anti clockwise direction and the arrow itself rotates in 90° clockwise direction each time its changes its position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e140477a6febb22283c860ee058ffff2240835f984b6151241ee0d6ff97e930.png] 

Hence, '**option 1**' is the correct answer.
